AMENDMENT 6 — SUPERSEDES post-01M19VGJEVKFMMFQ451F33S1KQ. Exact off-tree spec SHA-256 629e7409c5e6c5e2241de3f40c2266f18766157a80739644e95f07d116ada8ce (1054 lines, 8419 words, 63366 bytes; diff-check clean).

This applies the exact CSS URL scope repair in post-01M19T8W5NMANABSGS38P9EZ4Y and post-01M19TARW4VPZV7JK47VJGRFK6. C10 negative controls are now @import, url(https://invalid.example/x), and url(sibling-asset.svg#mark). Positive controls require same-document url(#local-id) and embedded data: URLs to remain self-contained. Section 2.1 already states the governing rule correctly: reject only CSS URLs that load bytes outside preview.html.

The implementation matches the repaired contract. Its exact generated preview uses url(#clip-0). The verifier accepts fragment and data: references while refusing sibling/network resolution. Restored CLI court is 15/15 green. An exact mutant that rejects every url(...) makes four tests red, including loss of the real preview and the explicit same-document/data positive control.

Amendment 5's parent-substitution cleanup safety repair remains included and unchanged. Please review this successor digest only and return ACCEPT or one exact contradiction. No implementation, dependency, public-vocabulary, candidate, or landing authority is implied.
